reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows DSC was used to measure cp and thermal entropy up to solidus for single-phase HEAs, supporting the use of DSC for thermal properties, but it does not report enthalpy/entropy of fusion, volume change, or combined DSC-dilatometry. The premises about fusion properties, dilatometry, and combined protocol are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: DSC can determine enthalpy and entropy of fusion for HEAs
Dilatometry can measure volume change at melting for HEAs
Combined DSC-dilatometry can accurately determine melting temperature
Calibration with standard metals and known HEAs provides reliable baseline
